correctness.rationale: For any rank-exactly-2s plane, the radical K has dimension d and the local alternating Schur complement is a submersion to wedge^2(K*): surjectivity follows from the nondegenerate ambient symplectic pairing V/L -> K*. This gives codimension binomial(d,2), smoothness on the top orbit, lower-rank singularities, and a conormal injection A |-> inclusion(K,L) o A o q_K preserving rank. Pfaffian kernel-dimension parameterization gives irreducible rank strata/codimensions; the even determinant-as-Pfaffian identity and standard exact generic odd Pfaffian resolution yield the two fiber degree formulas. The included self-contained verifier checks exact small dimensions, not the infinite proof. Critical nonstandard input is the 1977 Buchsbaum--Eisenbud resolution, identified explicitly.

value.rationale: The conormal-rank invariant was only recently defined for arbitrary subvarieties; symplectic restriction-rank orbit closures form a canonical infinite family, not an arbitrary numerical slice. The normal-slice/radical calculation resolves every nontrivial orbit-closure parameter, locates its singular boundary, and gives sharp parity-dependent codimension and degree of the first projective conormal defect. It distinguishes codimension-one and codimension-three degeneracy behavior that affects how conormal-rank methods apply to homogeneous symplectic geometry. Standard Pfaffian degrees are used but not passed off as new independent facts.
